entries.en: I told you. They're watching me!
entries.ro: I told you. They're watching me!

entries.en: He was right…! Blue eyes… They're everywhere… I know what I saw…! They're watching me… They must have me bugged.
entries.ro: Avea dreptate…! Blue Eyes… Sunt peste tot… Știu ce am văzut…! Mă urmăresc… Trebuie că m-au pus sub ascultare.

entries.en: The neighbor next door looks at me weird… He came over… Maybe.. I don't know, I left for a moment.
entries.ro: Vecinul de alături mă privește ciudat… A venit la mine… Poate… Nu știu, am ieșit o clipă.

entries.en: Are you taking me to your mothership?
entries.ro: Are you taking me to your mothership?

entries.en: I knew it! How long have you been tracking me?!
entries.ro: Știam eu! De cât timp mă urmărești?!
